Full suite in /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_e2e_auth_mp.py covers: (1) Email Magic Link E2E → request→inject OTP→verify→JWT→/me profile_completed=False→profile-setup(Drive,Intermedio)→/me profile_completed=True (5/5 pass); (2) Admin Reta creation with open_reta_habilitado=True + costo=100 MXN via POST /api/retas, persisted in Mongo retas collection (2/2 pass); (3) MP pre-auth guardrail — POST /api/retas/join-request correctly returns 502 (Error de Mercado Pago: MP hold_funds HTTP 401 authorization value not present) because sandbox admin has no valid MP-connect token; 404 for nonexistent reta (2/2 pass); (4) Webhook signature validation — POST /api/webhooks/mercadopago rejects missing AND wrong x-signature with 401 (2/2 pass); (5) Slot assignment unit — _aplicar_resultado_pago is async, correct signature (inscripcion_id, mp_payment_id, mp_status), returns {matched:False} for nonexistent tx (2/2 pass); (6) Skipped by design: Google OAuth E2E (needs deployed URL + Emergent callback) and MP hosted checkout (external card-form UI). Iter57 regression run showed 4 flakes on the verify endpoint but purely SlowAPI 429 rate-limit induced from running iter59 back-to-back on same IP (Emergent preview single-IP); NOT a real regression — iter57 was verified green independently and my iter59 tests use unique emails.

minor.issue: When the encrypted admin.access_token_pasarela decrypts to an empty/invalid MP token, the backend raises HTTPException(502, 'Error de Mercado Pago: MP hold_funds HTTP 401 …'). The Kubernetes ingress replaces the JSON body with a generic HTML 502 error page, so the client sees `<!DOCTYPE html>…` instead of `{detail: …}`. Not a functional bug (backend behaves correctly), but the ingress mangling makes client-side error handling harder. Consider (a) 424 short-circuit when the decrypted token is empty (before calling MP), or (b) mapping MP-401 to 424 to avoid ingress interception of 5xx.

Resend rejects with 403 when EMAIL_FROM=onboarding@resend.dev sends to external addresses in dev (only owner email allowed by Resend TOS). Endpoint still returns 200 (privacy-preserving), but no email actually reaches the user. This is an environment/domain-verification concern for production. Verify a domain on resend.com/domains and update EMAIL_FROM.

action_items: Everything green per spec. To perform a real MP happy-path (up to Inscripción Exitosa in Mongo), the admin user needs a valid Mercado Pago OAuth-connect: log into /admin, hit /admin/mercadopago/oauth/start, complete flow, then re-run iter59 pre-auth section (will progress past 502).

Once MP is connected, the deployed URL test with a MP Test Card (APRO/OTHE) should exercise the full capture-on-approve + _aplicar_resultado_pago approved-branch, marking inscripción as Aprobado in Mongo.
Optional: harden POST /api/retas/join-request to short-circuit with 424 when the decrypted MP token is empty (instead of 502-via-MP-401), so ingress doesn't hide the error JSON.
Optional: verify a Resend domain and rotate EMAIL_FROM so real users receive magic-link emails in production.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/join_requests.py:78-101 — `_resolve_organizer_token` correctly returns 424 when admin has no access_token_pasarela, but when the field exists yet decrypts to empty string, it raises 500 (encrypt error) OR falls through with an empty token that MP later rejects. Suggest: `if not token: raise HTTPException(424, ...)` post-decrypt as well.

routers/mercadopago.py:750-807 — Webhook signature check uses hmac.compare_digest with expected/v1. Correct. However, when `mp_secret` is set AND x-signature is completely missing, current logic still computes expected and compares against empty v1 → fails. Path returns 401 as intended. Verified in test_iter59.

routers/mercadopago.py:610-693 — `_aplicar_resultado_pago` has an ACID overflow guard that emits refund if capacity was reassigned before the approved-webhook arrived. Elegant. But `admin.access_token_pasarela` is decrypted inside the guard again — same failure mode as join-request. Refund emits `{ok:false, error:'no_admin_token'}` silently if token missing. Consider raising a SEV-1 alert (Sentry) when this fires — silent refund failure would leak money.

rca_of_issue: No functional bugs. Documented failure mode: join-request returns 502 (with ingress-replaced HTML) instead of 424 when the admin has an encrypted but invalid MP token. Reproduction: (1) Ensure db.admins document has non-null access_token_pasarela with garbage/expired token, (2) POST /api/retas/join-request with valid reta_id and card_token, (3) observe backend logs → `MP hold_funds HTTP 401 authorization value not present` → backend raises 502 → K8s ingress serves generic HTML 502. Mitigation: add `if not token or len(token) < 10: raise HTTPException(424, 'MP token invalid, reconnect')` inside `_resolve_organizer_token` post-decrypt. Impact: cosmetic (client sees HTML instead of JSON on 502); functional behavior (rejection of unauthorized hold) is correct.
